messages:
Carmen (Design): quick pass on the vectors preview + export interactions. added a tiny figma update: https://figma.com/file/new-flow
Elliot (Frontend): thanks. what's the minimum list of issues to fix before QA? 
Carmen (Design): top three: 1) multi-page selection is confusing (users think select applies to all pages). 2) export modal focus return goes to an invisible element. 3) small copy tweaks—export CTA doesn't show filetype.
Noah (A11y): for (1) announce selection via aria-live ("7 rows selected"). persist selection in a place screen readers can reference. for (2) dialog should be role=dialog, aria-modal=true, trap focus and return to trigger.
Samira (PM): product preference: default "Download selected vectors (.jsonl)". CSV should be explicit: "Export CSV — map columns" and trigger a mapping step with a live preview row.
Ravi (Backend): backend accepts ids array for export. for big jobs (>10k ids) we'll create background export and email user with download link.
Elliot (Frontend): implementation plan: persistent selection store (localStorage + server reconcile), aria-live counter in the header, focus management on modal close -> return to header CTA. also make truncated metadata cells keyboard-focusable and show an accessible tooltip + copy button (aria-label="Copy full value").
Carmen (Design): microcopy: primary CTA => "Download selected vectors (.jsonl)". secondary => "Export CSV — map columns". show small helper under CSV: "Map fields to columns; preview below." keep it concise.
Noah (A11y): extra nit: relevance badge contrast at 12px is <3:1. bump color or use white text on darker chip. add aria-sort on sortable headers and announce sort changes via aria-live.
Samira (PM): UX decision: when selection spans pages, header should show "Download (7) ▾" with dropdown. persist last CSV mapping per-user and offer "Apply recent mapping" in modal.
Ravi (Backend): we'll store recent mappings in user prefs and return them in the export modal API. we'll also return estimated payload size for warnings.
DeployBot: staging deploy succeeded with small updates. :shipit:
Carmen (Design): next steps: Elliot adds selection persistence + a11y bits; Ravi adds mapping API; Noah drafts a 6-point a11y checklist for the PR; Samira to sign off on copy. target PRs by Thursday EOD. :thumbsup:
